description: This file defines a React component named RolesPage which manages the display, creation, editing, and searching of roles within a web application. It interacts with backend APIs to fetch and modify role data, and provides UI elements for user interaction.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of roles from the primary endpoint, with a fallback to a secondary endpoint if necessary.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes the form state to create a new role.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with existing role data for editing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form data for required fields before saving.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the role data by either creating a new role or updating an existing one via API calls.
